scenarios.title: Researcher onboarding
scenarios.protocol_path: identity → sovereignty bundle → backed vault → policy selection
scenarios.positive_outcome: The researcher obtains portable protocol state and mints credits only against backing.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Missing sovereignty protections or insufficient backing is rejected.

scenarios.title: Create and verify a lemma
scenarios.protocol_path: CLAIM → COMMIT → FORMALIZE → PROVE → REPRODUCE → CERTIFY
scenarios.positive_outcome: Three independent observations reproduce one exact artifact under the selected trust policy.
scenarios.negative_invariant: A producer cannot self-certify, and missing or divergent evidence cannot advance.

scenarios.title: Pay with researcher credits
scenarios.protocol_path: deposit backing → mint Rᵢ → authorize maximum → settle actual → unlock remainder
scenarios.positive_outcome: Only consumed credits burn and release an equal amount of neutral backing.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Over-authorization, replay, or under-collateralization fails without partial mutation.

scenarios.title: Earn from a verified result
scenarios.protocol_path: settled external revenue → costs/refunds/reserves → bounded waterfall → cash + compounding
scenarios.positive_outcome: Net revenue is conserved and auto-compounded credits receive matching vault backing.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Token appreciation, unsettled revenue, or an unauthorized impact signal cannot fund payouts.

scenarios.title: Support a decentralized researcher
scenarios.protocol_path: grant / bounty / compute pre-purchase / public-goods support → typed funding receipt
scenarios.positive_outcome: Funding has an explicit rail, backing source, restrictions, and settlement evidence.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Self-issued inflation and vague passive-profit promises do not qualify as funding.

trace.step: grant / bounty / compute pre-purchase / public-goods support

scenarios.title: Operate a prover node
scenarios.protocol_path: advertise capacity → calibrated quote → candidate generation → compute receipt
scenarios.positive_outcome: A provider-neutral prover can earn for bounded work and return a candidate artifact.
scenarios.negative_invariant: The proof producer is excluded from independent reproduction of its own candidate.

scenarios.title: Operate a checker node
scenarios.protocol_path: credential chain → advertisement → sortition → exact execution → commit/reveal → work payment
scenarios.positive_outcome: Distinct verified users, operators, clusters, providers, regions, and checker families reproduce the job.
scenarios.negative_invariant: More machines under common control do not create more independence or truth weight.

scenarios.title: Challenge a certificate
scenarios.protocol_path: challenge → counterevidence → expanded reproduction → dismiss / quarantine / reject
scenarios.positive_outcome: A valid challenge can move the object into fail-closed quarantine and later revalidation.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Checker divergence is never resolved by a 2-to-1 majority or by slashing honest dissent.

scenarios.title: Reuse an upstream lemma
scenarios.protocol_path: final proof dependency → separate economic edge → settled revenue → bounded nonrecursive pool
scenarios.positive_outcome: Eligible upstream contributors can receive a capped allocation from an authorized pool.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Formal dependency alone creates no debt; stuffing, cycles, dust, and recursive charging are blocked.

scenarios.title: Publish a negative result
scenarios.protocol_path: failed or inconclusive work → attributable evidence artifact → commons/public-goods funding
scenarios.positive_outcome: Useful negative evidence remains publishable and fundable without a false validity badge.
scenarios.negative_invariant: Negative results cannot be relabeled as certified proofs or used to mint unbacked credits.

scenarios.title: Correct or supersede work
scenarios.protocol_path: new immutable object → AMENDS / CORRECTS / SUPERSEDES edge → revalidation
scenarios.positive_outcome: The old artifact, attribution, receipts, and correction lineage remain reconstructable.
scenarios.negative_invariant: A superseded record cannot silently return to published state or overwrite history.

limitations: The Lean gate is an author-operated pseudo self-test using the checker bundled with the same pinned Lean distribution; independent checker replay, nanoda replay, and a hostile clean-room corpus are not claimed.

Formal consensus simulation consumes structurally valid content-derived observations; production ingress must additionally authenticate node signatures, credentials, committee assignments, and non-revocation proofs.

ASTRA/model calls, live x402/stablecoin settlement, chains, remote storage providers, credential issuers, and randomness beacons remain deterministic reference adapters or fixtures rather than production external services.

The x402 replay guard and artifact store are local single-process reference implementations; production deployments require durable distributed idempotency, reconciliation, replication, credentialed signers, and monitored recovery.
No independent implementation, clean-room bundle reproduction, cryptographic audit, smart-contract audit, sandbox audit, economic audit, or legal review is claimed.
Passing scenarios demonstrate internal consistency of the checked snapshot, not theorem novelty, informal-statement alignment, commercial value, or production safety.
